title: Amazing tour
text: Eduardo was Amazing! I took my mom on the tour who has mobility issues walking we had a travel scooter and Eduardo personalized the trip so my mom was able to see all sights without all the stairs. He made this trip very special and treated us like his family! Thank you for a memorable and blessed trip!

title: Private tour Tarragona and Sitges
text:

We especially appreciated that he gave us time to explore on our own and enjoy special moments together as a family, rather than making us feel rushed.

author: Michelle_M

title: Wonderful, disability-friendly
text:
My daughter and I had a wonderful time with Adele and Agosto. After a smooth pickup at our hotel, we were driven to Tarragona to see the aquaduct (my favorite!), and the Roman circus/arena by the sea. On the way back we went to Sitges for lunch and some beach time. 

The thing that really stood out for me was how this tour made the day so much more accessible for me, in a way that let me decide at every point what I felt comfortable doing. title: Don't miss this
